audience: AP and finance teams at construction companies
headline: Still keying invoices into the ERP?
symptoms: Every invoice is matched to its PO by hand
Retainage and blank lien waivers slip through
Posting takes minutes per invoice, hundreds of times a month
build: Invoice intake that reads the invoice, pulls the PO or subcontract, checks one against the other and types it into your ERP. The AP clerk and the project manager each approve before it moves on.

screens.caption: Shared AP inbox, three kinds of invoice
Invoice read and matched against the PO
AP clerk gate: nothing posts without the clerk
Typed into the ERP, field by field
